reply_text:
There's no firm deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form yet. The last word we have conflicts, so I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread and asked Marcus to confirm.

What I told her:
- **Morning of 14 Oct:** Marcus posted in #north-team that the signed order form is due 24 December.
- **Noon on 14 Oct:** He corrected that in #north-random to 15 August, saying Thornbury's ops lead had corrected him.
- **No answer since:** 15 August had already passed by then. I asked him at the time whether they meant a different month or next year, and I haven't seen a reply.

Ilse is in both channels, and a deadline isn't a money figure, so no approval was needed. One thing to know: the 24 December message didn't show up when I read #north-team directly. That date comes from the knowledge brain's saved record of the post and my own reply to it at the time.
